blocked_reasons: No candidate simultaneously preserves the intended global resource objective and provides a defensible new local-credit mechanism.
Candidate A has identifiable channels but an unresolved normative objective and insufficient distance from causal effect decomposition.
Candidate B is methodologically sound but directly covered by constrained policy optimization and safe multi-agent RL.
Candidate C requires additional causal assumptions and may optimize a counterfactual continuation outside the factual policy distribution.
prohibited_actions: Do not start 10k, 30k, or 100k online training for any N1 candidate.
Do not assign seeds, states, budgets, or thresholds after observing candidate training outcomes.
Do not rename candidate A and treat the ledger decomposition as an established algorithm.
Do not restore BPCE-PPO, MCH-PPO, or a GNN extension through this task.
Do not override this file with a command-line flag.
reentry_requirements: Freeze a new normative objective: global budget, local responsibility, or a formally defined bilevel relation.
Provide a formula-level novelty matrix against CPO/safe MARL and 2025 counterfactual effect decomposition.
State one falsifiable mechanism prediction and an equal-capacity non-mechanism control.
Include global CMDP as a required strong baseline.
Freeze new non-overlapping seeds, states, budgets, metrics, thresholds, and stop rules before online execution.
Verify sampling, ratios, clipping, optimizer state, and one-step parameter updates exactly match the frozen baseline when the new coefficient is zero.
